QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Mysterious Past, Brilliant Future
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Eremos to find out where your next trial is to take place.
QuestInfo.1: Eremose directs you to the Excavation Site for the next phase of your training. The bone fragments discovered there are very valuable, archaeologically speaking. It seems the Ryuul are very passionate about the subject. Further their research by collecting 1,000 Old Bone Fragments.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered and analyzed Old Bone Fragments from the Excavation Site. The Ryuul are fascinated by them.
